label: Augmented Human Reference
warning: The reference contains seven observed complete questionnaires and 23 synthetic bootstrap questionnaires; it is not a study of 30 independent participants.
method: For each image task, select the two complete observed questionnaires with the highest BBox Acc@0.5, breaking ties by mIoU and then semantic accuracy. For each video level, select the two questionnaires with the highest F1@0.5, breaking ties by mtIoU and then semantic accuracy. Retain all seven observed questionnaires and generate 23 synthetic questionnaires by balanced source rotation and within-task bootstrap resampling.
